about.title: About Interest Only Mortgage Calculator - Payment Analysis Tool
about.description: The Interest Only Mortgage Calculator is a loan analysis tool designed to help you understand the costs and implications of interest-only mortgage payments. This calculator shows monthly payments during the interest-only period, total interest costs, and payment changes when principal payments begin. Whether you're considering an interest-only loan or comparing mortgage options, this tool provides payment structure analysis and long-term cost estimates.

faq.q: Who should consider an interest-only mortgage?
faq.a: Interest-only mortgages may benefit borrowers with irregular income, those expecting income increases, real estate investors, or buyers in appreciating markets who plan to sell before the interest-only period ends.

faq.q: What happens when the interest-only period ends?
faq.a: Payments increase significantly as you begin paying principal and interest on the remaining loan balance. For example, a $400,000 loan might jump from $2,000/month to $2,800/month when the interest-only period ends.

Yes, they carry risks including payment shock, no equity building through payments, potential negative equity if property values decline, and refinancing challenges if credit or income situations change.

faq.q: Can I make principal payments during the interest-only period?
faq.a: Most interest-only loans allow voluntary principal payments without penalty. Making extra principal payments can reduce the payment shock when the interest-only period ends and build equity faster.
